fema.monster_video_options.title: Video Options - Vertical Video & Resolution
fema.monster_video_options.description:
Did you make a fancy new video feed? Neat! But is it pulling in some nasty horizontal video? Use this to filter them out for majestic 9:16 goodness. You can also remove SD, HD, or UHD resolutions, allowing you to create a lo-fi video feed or a high-quality only feed. Filter by file size to target longer videos, set custom dimension limits for precise control, or exclude GIFs entirely.
